info.name: Oriah local
info.description:
Generated by scripts/local-dev/postman_from_openapi.py from the services' own OpenAPI descriptions -- regenerate after an API change. See docs/LOCAL_DEV.md.

Start with "0. Log in". Requests go through the gateway ({{baseUrl}}) unless marked.

item.name: 0. Log in
as maya (staff, job role OWNER)

exec: console.log('bearerToken is now maya\'s, valid ' + body.expires_in + ' s');

request.description: Logs in as maya and stores the token in the environment as bearerToken; every other request in this collection sends it. Tokens last 30 minutes.

item.name: as alice (customer)

exec: console.log('bearerToken is now alice\'s, valid ' + body.expires_in + ' s');

request.description: Logs in as alice and stores the token in the environment as bearerToken; every other request in this collection sends it. Tokens last 30 minutes.

catalog
Create a category

request.description: The slug is derived from the name. A client-chosen slug is a client choosing a URL, and two would collide in a way only the unique index notices.

item.name: Remove a category

request.description: Child categories move up to this one's parent and products keep existing -- only the membership links go. A taxonomy edit must never be able to delete something sellable.

item.name: Rename, move or reposition a category

request.description: Partial: null fields are left alone. Renaming does NOT change the slug -- it is in storefront URLs and in anyone's bookmarks, so the label and the address are separate concerns.

item.name: The priced pieces that stand below cost (or with no cost known, or in the wrong currency), judged on what a customer pays

request.description: Every priced, active variant of a sellable product that has not been deleted, compared with the stock held NOW, so a dearer lot received, a corrected cost, a dear lot sold out of or a changed default box shows here the next time anyone looks. The comparison is made on the NET price: the list price (`price`) less the promotion in force (`discountPerPiece`, `promotionId`, `netPrice`). `at` (now or later) applies the promotions that will be in force then, which is how an admin sees what a promotion that has not started yet will do; `promotionId` lists only the pieces that promotion discounts (and the counts are about those pieces). `status` filters (BELOW by default; NO_COST_KNOWN, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, OK, or ALL); `counts` gives every status whatever the status filter. Biggest shortfall first. A promotion never needs a reason and is never refused: it is warned about here.

item.name: A variant's price, its dated history, the cost it stands against and a suggestion

request.description: The cost is read from stock afresh. `targetProfitPercent` (0 to 1000, at most two decimals) asks for a suggested price of the landed cost plus that percentage of it; without it the configured percentage is used, and if there is none there is no suggestion. A suggestion is never applied.

item.name: Set a variant's price, compared with what the stock cost

request.description: Adds a row of dated history and overwrites nothing. A price below the dearest unit cost still held (plus the dearest held cost of the product's default box) is a 409 `below-landed-cost` carrying every figure; saving it needs `belowCostReason` and the `acknowledgedFloor` the person saw. Nothing is saved without the cost having been looked at: if stock cannot be asked the answer is 503. Prices are in ZMW. `expectedPriceId` is the id of the price the person saw in force (null: unpriced); a price saved in between is `stale-price`.

item.name: List products for an operator, drafts and packaging included

request.description: Every product that has not been deleted, newest first, whatever its status or kind. Each row carries its variants. `kind` and `status` filter; `q` is plain text matched case-insensitively against the title and every variant's SKU (a percent sign or underscore in it means itself). A page is at most 100 rows; one past the end is empty.

item.name: Create a product

request.description: `kind` is SELLABLE (the default) or PACKAGING and is fixed for the life of the product. Packaging is stocked and costed like anything else but is never published and never priced: it is typed PACKAGING, and its variants are created at 0.00.

item.name: One product by id, including DRAFT and ARCHIVED
Delete a product
Partially update a product
Choose, change or clear a product's default box
Upload an image for a product

request.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. The bytes are re-encoded: EXIF is applied and then stripped (so a supplier's GPS coordinates are not published and the photograph is not left sideways), and the stored content type comes from decoding the file rather than from the request. Uploading the same bytes twice returns the first image.

item.name: Image bytes for any product, published or not
Delete one of a product's images
Publish a product, if it has an active variant priced above zero
Take a published product off sale (back to DRAFT)
Add a variant to a product
Name up to 100 variants

request.description:
**Not routed by the gateway** -- internal to the services, so this calls catalog directly on port 8081.

Internal. Read-only despite being a POST. One entry per requested id, in request order: found = false for an id that is no variant. A deleted product's variant is found and flagged productDeleted. Identity only, never a price.

item.name: The packaging a sale can go out in

request.description:
**Not routed by the gateway** -- internal to the services, so this calls catalog directly on port 8081.

Internal. Every active variant of a packaging product that is not deleted, by name and SKU. Identity only, never a price or a cost.

item.name: Price up to 100 variants at a past instant

request.description:
**Not routed by the gateway** -- internal to the services, so this calls catalog directly on port 8081.

Internal. Read-only despite being a POST. Each requested id is answered, in request order, with the list price in force at the instant, the promotion that applied then and the net price. A piece with no price yet at that instant is NO_PRICE_AT_DATE (never zero, never today's price); a packaging entry or an unknown id is UNKNOWN. Today's publication state is ignored: a piece withdrawn since was still sold at its price on the day.

item.name: The category tree, roots first, each with its children nested
One category by its slug
Image bytes for a published product

request.description: Served with a one-year immutable cache and a strong ETag taken from the stored content hash. Returns 404 -- not 403 -- when the owning product is not ACTIVE, because a 403 would confirm that the image exists. Range requests are ignored and the full entity is returned.

item.name: Product types with their declared attributes, in display order
List published products, filtered and sorted

request.description: Returns ACTIVE products only. DRAFT and ARCHIVED are never listed, which is also why the catalogue looks empty immediately after the variants migration: it left every pre-existing product DRAFT because none of them had a price anyone had chosen. `orderBy` is named that way rather than `sort` so it does not collide with Spring's own paging `sort` parameter, and it is a closed set of values because the ordering has to be built into SQL -- a caller-supplied sort expression would be an injection. `category` matches the category AND its descendants, so filtering by a parent returns everything beneath it. An unknown category slug is a 400, unlike an unknown `tag`, which answers 200 with an empty page: a tag is a free-form label whose absence means nothing, while a category is a closed set. Price filtering uses the cheapest PURCHASABLE variant -- active and priced above zero -- so a deactivated or unpriced variant cannot pull a product into a price band a customer cannot actually buy at.

item.name: Who owns the catalog service, and how to reach them
One product by id, enriched with stock availability
Resolve prices for up to 100 variants

request.description: Read-only despite being a POST: the identifier list is too long for a URL. Each requested id is answered with a status of PRICED, UNPUBLISHED or UNKNOWN, in request order. An UNPUBLISHED entry deliberately carries no price, so a caller that skips the status check fails loudly rather than charging for something that is not for sale.

item.name: inventory
What the stock still held cost, per variant: each held lot, the dearest cost and the weighted average

request.description: `variantIds` is a comma-separated list of at most 100 distinct ids. Every id is answered once, in the order first asked; a variant that was never received is answered with nothing held and no cost. A price is compared with `highestUnitCost` (the dearest lot still holding stock), never with the average.

item.name: The lots: what each slice of each received consignment line cost per unit, and how many are still held

request.description: Oldest first, which is the order oldest-first selling draws in. Each lot carries the names it was received under.

item.name: The ledger: what every action (a receipt, a sale, a write-off, a give-away, a take-back, a correction) did to each lot, at the lot's cost

request.description: In the order the rows were written. A row a correction reversed is no longer live, but stays on record; the cost released by a row is -qtyDelta x unitCost.

item.name: All stock records, scarcest first, optionally only out-of-stock
The boxes set aside, by product or by box

request.description: Oldest first. With neither filter, every record.

item.name: Set boxes aside for a product, on its default box

request.description: The box is the product's default box, which inventory learned from the catalogue. Again for the same product it replaces its record: more takes from free, fewer gives back, the same changes nothing. Needs free boxes (a box is never promised twice): otherwise 409 `insufficient-free-packaging` with `available`, the most that can be set aside for this product. A product inventory has not heard of yet is 409 `product-state-not-received`, one with no default box `no-default-box`.

item.name: Let a product's boxes go: they are free again and nothing leaves the building
Everything done to a product's boxes, in order: set aside, replaced, let go, sold, cut by a write-off

request.description: Append-only. Each entry says what, how many, how many were left set aside after it, who or what caused it and when.

item.name: Swap the box of a paid order: reverse the original box's sale and sell the replacement

request.description: One transaction, keyed by the amendment id. Both rows are dated to the day of the sale and recorded now. Boxes go back to free. A repeat of the same swap answers it (replay: true) and changes nothing.

item.name: Check every stock count against its cost lots, and every lot against its ledger

request.description: One count, not three: on-hand must equal what the current lots hold. Counts only, no cost. A clean system reports no mismatches.

item.name: Hold an order's pieces and their boxes, all or nothing

request.description: A shortage on any line holds nothing and names every short line. Asking again with the same reservation id holds nothing more. An order holds one reservation at a time.

item.name: A reservation as it stands
The order has paid: sell every line, dated to the money

request.description: Pieces and boxes drain their oldest lots in one transaction, each under the order's own sale-line id. Idempotent: consuming again answers the same sale. A hold that has lapsed cannot be sold, even before the sweep has ended it.

item.name: Stretch the hold (a payment reference was submitted)

request.description: Never beyond a day from when it was made, and never shorter than it is.

item.name: Let go of the hold

request.description: Pieces and boxes go back where they came from. Releasing a reservation that is not held (sold, released, expired) changes nothing.

item.name: Write-offs and give-aways, newest first, each with what has come back and what is still out
Write stock off, or give it away: the oldest lots, at their cost, released into the month it happened

request.description: Only stock nobody has reserved can go. The same requestId with the same fields answers again (200) and takes nothing; the same requestId for anything else is a 409.

item.name: One write-off or give-away, with what has come back
Some of what was written off or given away comes back: to the lots it left, newest first, at the same cost
Who owns the inventory service, and how to reach them

request.description: **Not routed by the gateway** -- internal to the services, so this calls inventory directly on port 8082.

item.name: Stock for one variant

request.description: **Not routed by the gateway** -- internal to the services, so this calls inventory directly on port 8082.

Partially update the caller's profile

Set a line item's quantity
payment
All payment intents, newest first, optionally filtered by status
Claims, newest first; optionally of one order

request.description: Each says whether money is already recorded for it (`moneyRecorded`) and whether its reference is used for another order (`usedElsewhere`).

item.name: One claim
Reject a claim as false

request.description: `NOT_FOUND_AT_PROVIDER` needs `evidence` (ten characters or more). `REFERENCE_ALREADY_USED` is checked by the service: the same reference must already be confirmed for another order (held money counts, a voided confirmation does not). A claim whose reference already has money recorded for its own order cannot be rejected. Posts nothing and does not use the reference.

item.name: Record money that reached Oriah

request.description: Method, reference (cash needs none), gross, fee and the date the money ARRIVED. Net is gross less fee and is never accepted. A reference confirms money once. Money older than 72 hours needs BACKDATE_SALE and a backdateReason. `Idempotency-Key` is required: the same key and request answers the same confirmation (200).

item.name: Confirmations order has not answered yet, oldest first

request.description: Money recorded that nothing has acted on yet. `stuck` is true once one has waited longer than the settlement window (five minutes): someone should look. Settled, held and voided confirmations are not listed.

item.name: One confirmation, with what became of the money
Take back a confirmation keyed wrongly

request.description: Needs a reason of at least ten characters. Frees the reference so the corrected confirmation can use it, closes the money held for it and announces payment.voided. A confirmation that paid a sale is never voided.

item.name: Money owed back to customers, newest first

request.description: `status` is OWED (the default), VOIDED (its confirmation was voided as keyed wrongly) or ALL.

item.name: Exact ledger totals: counts by status and captured money per currency
Who owns the payment service, and how to reach them
order
All orders, paged
Orders whose shopper says they have paid, soonest to lapse first

request.description: Each carries the method and reference the shopper gave, for staff to find in the bank or the provider's records and confirm (or reject). With orderId: that one order if it can still take money (waiting for payment, claimed, or lapsed), so money can be confirmed for a customer who never typed a reference. At most 100.

item.name: The packer's work list: paid orders to pack, packed, or on the way

request.description: Oldest payment first, at most 100. A row says who the parcel is for, by what option and to which town, how many pieces, and whether it can be packed (an order placed before Phase 8 has no recipient or address kept and is marked not packable). No money, no logins.

item.name: Recorded orders, newest first

request.description: `q` finds by the caller's phone in any spelling (exact), a receipt number, a slip number (exact) or a name (a prefix of three letters or more); `status` narrows. At most 50 a page. A phone is masked in the list.

item.name: Record a sale for a caller with no account, and hold its pieces

request.description: Staff say who is buying, what, how it goes and (for a paper sale) when; the server dates and prices everything itself (no price, discount or total can be typed) and the person confirms the total they read to the caller in `expectedTotal`. A repeat with the same `Idempotency-Key` and request is the same order (200); the pieces are held for ten minutes, and payment is the staff confirmation of money (`POST /api/v1/admin/payments/confirmations`).

item.name: The boxes a sale can go out in

request.description: Catalog's packaging, by name and SKU (no price): what a salesperson picks from when the product's own box has run out. Read with the person's token.

item.name: Where Oriah can deliver and by what, with no price

request.description: Shipping's own list of the towns and options that are switched on: what a salesperson picks from when a delivery is agreed by phone.

item.name: Price a sale to read the total to the caller, writing and holding nothing

request.description: The same pricing as recording, with no key, no hold and no personal data: no caller, no recipient, no address and no expected total.

item.name: One recorded order

request.description: The caller's phone and the parcel's address are shown while the order is alive and withheld once it is delivered. A web order is 404.

item.name: Cancel a recorded order that is waiting for money

request.description: Its hold goes and the recipient and address are forgotten; the caller is kept. A paid order is 409 (a paid sale is undone by a return, never a status change).

item.name: The receipt to give the caller

request.description: Ours, never a tax invoice, with no VAT line: the receipt number, the day it was paid, the caller's name only, every line and the total.

item.name: Confirmed money that has not paid its sale

request.description: In flight (stuck when it has waited more than five minutes), waiting for a box (the box is named), unsettled with the reason it could not pay the sale, or voided. Newest first, at most 100. state: IN_FLIGHT, BLOCKED_BOX, UNSETTLED or VOIDED.

item.name: One order by id
Change the box of a paid order's line

request.description: Inventory reverses the original box's sale and sells the replacement, both dated to the day of the SALE (a swap never moves it); the line then carries the new box. Only a PAID order that has not been fulfilled. Send the same amendmentId to retry after a lost reply: a repeat answers the same swap (replay: true). Without one, the id is worked out from the line as it stands and the box asked for, so a plain retry of the same request is just as safe. The reason is judged trimmed.

item.name: Correct who a paid order is for and where it goes, before it is packed

request.description: Replaces the whole delivery block (nothing left out is kept); the previous details, who changed them and why are kept in an append-only history, and nothing is published. Only a PAID order that is not packed yet: once packed the label says where it goes. The option and the town the delivery was priced for are not changed here.

item.name: Make delivery free on an order that is still waiting for a payment reference

request.description: Delivery becomes K0.00 and the order's total falls by exactly what delivery would have cost; who, why, when and how much are kept on the order (delivery revenue given up, never goods revenue). Only an order that is CREATED with its pieces held and no money being applied: once a payment is claimed, being applied or made, the total cannot move. Staff must then confirm the new, lower total. One waiver per order.

item.name: The packing slip: who it is for, where it goes, what is in the parcel, and where the order stands

request.description: Only for an order that is paid. The delivery block (name, phone, address) is withheld once the order is delivered, except to an order administrator. No money, no logins, no actors; the fare only for a caller who may see cost (COST_VIEWER).

item.name: Record that the order was delivered (SHIPPED to DELIVERED); a pickup is handed over (FULFILLED to DELIVERED)

request.description: A pickup's hand-over is its dispatch, so it is refused while a box swap on the order is with inventory.

item.name: Pack a paid order (PAID to FULFILLED)

request.description: Records that the order was packed, at the time given (default now). A delivered order must have its recipient and address kept. A step already recorded answers 200 with replay: true when what you send matches, 409 otherwise.

item.name: Send a packed order (FULFILLED to SHIPPED), recording the courier fare when Oriah pays it

request.description: The parcel goes by the option the shopper chose. When Oriah pays the courier the fare it charged is required (K0.00 if nothing); when the recipient pays the courier, or it is Oriah's own delivery, a fare is refused. Never for a pickup (hand it over). Refused while a box swap on the order is with inventory. The delivery charge is never changed.

item.name: Drive an allowed FSM transition
Place an order
Who owns the order service, and how to reach them
The caller's orders, paged
One of the caller's own orders
Cancel one of the caller's own orders
Say how you paid: a mobile-money or bank-transfer reference

request.description: Not money: staff confirm the payment (or tell you they cannot find it). Giving a reference stretches the hold on your pieces to a day so they have time to look. Only an order waiting for payment can take one, and only once: the same reference again is the same claim, another is refused.

item.name: promotion
Promotions, newest first; optionally of one scope or only those in force now (true) or not (false)
Make a promotion; it may not start in the past
One promotion
Change a promotion: the old one stops now and the new one says which it replaces
End a promotion from now: it applied before this moment and does not after
Who owns the promotion service, and how to reach them
shipping
The options a parcel can go by
Add a courier or a bus company's parcel service
Switch an option on or off
Prices, drafts and history, optionally of one town, option or status
Draft a price for a town and option (a customer sees nothing until it is published)
Edit a draft price (a published price cannot be edited: draft a new one)
Discard a draft price (a published price is history and cannot be removed)
Publish a draft: it becomes the live price of its town and option, and the one it replaces becomes history
Zambia's ten provinces, each with how many towns it has
The free-delivery threshold (off until set)
Set the free-delivery threshold, or switch it off with null; judged on the goods total after discount
Every change to the free-delivery threshold, newest first, with who and why
Towns, optionally of one province or only those switched on or off
Add a town to a province
Switch a town on or off (a town is never deleted: orders point at it)
Who owns the shipping service, and how to reach them
Where Oriah can deliver and by what, with no prices (for staff agreeing a delivery by phone)

request.description: Every town and option that is switched on, whether or not a price is published for it. Shoppers are offered only published prices (`GET /towns`); this is the list a member of staff picks from when a delivery is agreed by phone or WhatsApp. No price appears in it.

item.name: The delivery price for one town and option, before paying

request.description: The amount is what goes on the order. The recipient paying the courier means K0; the free-delivery threshold is judged on the goods after discount. A town not yet priced is `town-not-offered` (the shop prices it first), never `outside the delivery area`.

item.name: Where Oriah delivers and what it costs: provinces, their towns, and each town's options with a published price

request.description: Only a town that is switched on, with an option that is switched on and a PUBLISHED price, is listed. Self-collect is always offered at no charge. The free-delivery threshold is shown when it is on.

Place the order and hold its pieces for the shopper

Price the caller's cart without committing anything

The caller's notifications, newest first

Reviews for one product, paged
Post or replace the caller's review of a product

The caller's own reviews, paged
Mark a review helpful

procurement
The consignments, newest first, optionally only drafts, received ones, or the opening one

query.description: true: only the opening consignment; false: all the others

item.name: Start a consignment

request.description: From WHOLE purchase orders (each with the version it was read at; they are frozen from now on), or, with opening = true, as the day-one stock typed in. Exactly one of the two.

item.name: One consignment, with its orders, lines and costs
Replace the header of a draft

request.description: The note, whether the costs are estimates, and the customs facts (charges basis, declarant, clearance form, ZRA assessment reference, licensed agent) are replaced as a whole: send every field you want kept. Send the version the change was made from.

item.name: Delete a draft

query.description: The consignment's version this was decided from

request.description: Its lines and costs go with it and its orders are set free. A received consignment is history and is never deleted.

item.name: What each unit costs, or would cost if received now

query.description: A received consignment's earlier revision (1 is the receipt itself); left out, the revision that stands

request.description: The courier's charge and every other cost shared out to the unit, to the ngwee. For a draft it is worked out afresh and changes nothing; when it cannot be costed yet, ready is false and problems says what to fix. For a received consignment it is the allocation recorded when the goods landed (revision, receivedAt), never recomputed; after a correction it is the latest revision unless one is asked for.

item.name: Correct the cost of a received consignment

body.raw:
{
  "fromRevision": 1,
  "reason": "The courier's bill was K600, not K6,000",
  "estimated": "",
  "costLines": "",
  "goodsLines": ""
}

request.description: The courier's bill was keyed wrong, a duty assessment arrived late, a supplier's total was mistyped. Nothing already recorded is edited: this adds a NEW revision of the allocation with the reason and who made it, worked out from the revision before it by the rules a draft is costed by, and announces (consignment.amended) each line whose cost it changed so inventory re-lays the new unit costs over the stock. Send fromRevision, the revision you were looking at, so two people never overwrite each other. costLines, when present, replaces the whole cost list; goodsLines corrects the goods totals it names. All or nothing.

item.name: Replace every cost line of a draft

request.description: What the courier charged, and any duty, surtax or import VAT (typed, never calculated; zero today). A bank or transfer charge is refused: the supplier price already is the total that left the bank. An empty list clears them.

item.name: A consignment's documents, newest first

request.description: Those in use; with includeVoided, the voided ones too (with who, when and why). The files themselves are downloaded one at a time.

item.name: Attach an invoice to a consignment

request.description: The courier's invoice, the supplier's, a ZRA assessment, or anything else that supports the costs. A PDF, JPEG or PNG of up to 5 MB, judged by its own first bytes. The same file is kept once while in use, and at most 10 are in use at a time. Allowed on a received consignment: an invoice often arrives after the goods.

item.name: Key what the line records about the goods

request.description: The chargeable weight (for the whole line, in whole grams), the country the goods came from and the HS code. Replaced as a whole: a field left out is cleared.

item.name: Replace every line of the opening consignment

request.description: Only for the opening consignment. Anything typed per line for a cost is cleared. Every variant is checked with the catalogue once.

item.name: Put one more whole purchase order into a draft

request.description: Its lines are copied onto the consignment and the order is frozen. Send the consignment's version and the order's.

item.name: Take a purchase order out of a draft

query.description: The consignment's version this was decided from

request.description: Its lines go, the rest are renumbered, anything typed for those lines goes, and the order is free to be changed or cancelled again.

item.name: The goods have landed

request.description: Works out what each unit cost and records it for good (revision 1), makes the consignment and every order in it RECEIVED, and announces each line (consignment.received) for inventory. All or nothing. From now on nothing about it changes. The opening stock must be received before any shipment. Send the version it was decided from.

item.name: Every revision of a received consignment's allocation

request.description: Oldest first: the receipt (1) and each correction with who made it, why, the totals and the lines whose cost it changed. A draft has none.

item.name: Who owns the procurement service, and how to reach them
Download a document

request.description: Always an attachment, with the type it really is, marked not to be sniffed or cached, and with a policy that lets it do nothing. Voided documents can still be downloaded.

item.name: Void a document that should not be relied on

request.description: It stays on record and downloadable, marked as voided, with who, when and why. There is no delete and no replace. A corrected copy is uploaded as a new document.

item.name: The orders, newest first, optionally one supplier's or one status
Place an order with one supplier

request.description: One line per item: the variant, how many, and the all-in total paid (as the bank app shows it). Every variant is checked with the catalogue once, here: it must exist, be switched on, and belong to a product that is not deleted or archived (a DRAFT product and packaging are fine).

item.name: One order
Change an open order

request.description: Only while the order is OPEN and not in a consignment (take it out of the consignment first). Send the version the change was made from. Fields left out are unchanged; lines, when sent, replace all the lines and are checked with the catalogue again.

item.name: Cancel an open order

request.description: Only while OPEN and not in a consignment. A cancelled order is history and never changes again.

item.name: A purchase order's documents, newest first
Attach an invoice to a purchase order

request.description: The supplier's invoice, or anything else that supports the order. A courier invoice or a ZRA assessment belongs to a consignment, not an order. A PDF, JPEG or PNG of up to 5 MB.

item.name: The suppliers, by name, optionally only those in use or those stopped, or matching some text

query.description: true: only suppliers in use; false: only those we have stopped using; absent: both
Names containing this text, ignoring letter case. % and _ are ordinary characters.

item.name: Add a supplier

body.raw:

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Example Trading Ltd",
  "country": "CN",
  "contactName": "A. Contact",
  "contactDetails": "WhatsApp +86 000 0000",
  "paymentNotes": "Bank transfer, in full, on shipping",

}

request.description: A field left out is unchanged. contactName, contactDetails and paymentNotes are cleared by sending null or blank text. name, country and active cannot be empty. "active": false stops using a supplier without deleting it.
